reason: A is the stronger proposal because it uses the literature-supported 5 at.% Sn level, defines explicit oxidation and mechanical-retention thresholds, and provides a more decisive controlled test. Both candidates over-extrapolate Nb-silicide results to HfNbTaTiZr and inadequately substantiate a protective Sn-rich oxide mechanism, but B additionally selects an unsupported 1–3 at.% range and makes vaguer, less physically grounded claims about grain-boundary oxygen diffusion and scale adherence.
